# 🧩 Documentation Templates

These templates support future changes and reviews. They are not evidence that the corresponding subsystem exists in this chatbot. For example, API and database templates are reusable formats; the current application has no HTTP API or database.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Record a durable technical decision |
| [Architecture](architecture-template.md) | Propose a system design |
| [API documentation](api-documentation-template.md) | Document an actual programmatic interface |
| [Database schema](database-schema-template.md) | Document a real schema if introduced |
| [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md) | Define a user-visible capability |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Capture reproducible defects |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md) | Record one verification case |
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Define test scope and exit criteria |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Record executed test evidence |
| [Threat assessment](threat-assessment-template.md) | Identify trust boundaries and risks |
| [Security audit](security-audit-template.md) | Record a security review |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Record terminal accessibility checks |
| [Incident report](incident-report-template.md) | Capture an incident |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Verify a tagged source release |
| [Deployment checklist](deployment-checklist.md) | Prepare executable distribution |
| [Rollback checklist](rollback-checklist.md) | Recover a faulty release |
| [Migration](migration-template.md) | Document version changes |
| [Risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md) | Rate and mitigate project risks |
| [Change request](change-request-template.md) | Review a proposed scope change |
| [Code review](code-review-template.md) | Review source and tests |
| [Project status](project-status-template.md) | Report verified status |
| [Meeting notes](meeting-notes-template.md) | Capture decisions and actions |
| [Maintenance checklist](maintenance-checklist.md) | Repeatable upkeep |

Additional templates cover benchmarks, compatibility matrices, feature proposals, and user feedback.
